column1: # gradle/phase5/zk-sources.tsv is the frozen Phase 5a inventory and records the
# pre-migration path of every ZK source file. When Phase 5d has to relocate a
# file, the move is recorded here so the inventory stays immutable and the
# compile-closure verification can still resolve every row to a real file.
